description: Return the connected user's current Vimshottari period and present sidereal transit snapshot (gochar), including transits to natal houses from the Ascendant and Moon and current antardasha and pratyantardasha. Free with a connected Vedara account that has a completed birth profile. Operates only within the connected user's bounded private Vedara account. Uses saved or explicitly supplied coordinates and Vedara calculations, without public geocoding, web search, external recipients, or public publishing. Authentication, audit events, and rate limits are private account operations.
name: get_my_timing
title: Get my current Vedic timing
